originalTitle: What to expect from Google’s 2026 Pixel hardware launch event

content: It’s that time of year: On Wednesday, Google is set to host its annual Made by Google hardware launch event for Pixel gadgets. Google itself has already teased new slab-style and foldable Pixel smartphones, but leaks also indicate that the company could announce updated watches, a new color for familiar earbuds, and perhaps a brand new AirTag-like item tracker. However, unusually, Google’s event is taking place in the evening: It kicks off on Wednesday at 6PM ET / 3PM PT instead of in the early afternoon or mid-morning, like many other tech events. And this time it has a celebrity host in Trevor Noah. Even more strange: As noted by 9to5Google, the Google Store homepage has a Pixel 11 preorder countdown that will end at 10AM ET on Wednesday — which is many hours earlier than the launch event itself. That could mean that all of the details about Google’s new devices will be officially revealed long before the company hosts the formal launch event.  Here’s what we expect to see Google announce this week. If you want to watch the event live, you can catch it on YouTube. The Pixel 11 lineup [Image: A leaked marketing render of the Pixel 11 Pro Fold. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/6608d2c0-7707-4156-82ca-a44b58a90bd1_1440x800.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Google has already hinted at its new phones while promoting the event, including shadowy glimpses of updated Pro and foldable phones. But the new smartphones could be largely iterative updates.  Google is expected to announce four new smartphones: the Pixel 11, the Pixel 11 Pro, the Pixel 11 Pro XL, and the Pixel 11 Pro Fold. Based on leaked images, they should look largely the same as the Pixel 10 lineup, though it appears they’ll have camera bars that are black all the way across and colors that might rule.  Perhaps the most notable visual difference will be a rainbow glowy light on the camera bar, which Google has already shown off for the Pixel 11 Pro. The company hasn’t yet specified what it’ll do or what it’s called. But code in Google’s contacts app spotted by 9to5Google indicates that it will be called “HiLight” and, at least for that contacts app, HiLight can be customized with different colors to indicate when certain people call you. Presumably, the light will work in some way with other apps as well. Based on a translation of a leaked Pixel 11 Pro Fold image, HiLight will also light up when you talk with Google’s Gemini AI. [Image: A tease from Google showing the new light. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/Screenshot-2026-07-15-at-11.36.30-AM.png?quality=90&strip=all] Inside the phones, it seems likely that they’ll be powered by a new Tensor G6 chip. It’s rumored that the new chip will use TSMC’s 2nm process, which is expected to bring performance and power efficiency gains. If it does launch with a 2nm chip, the Pixel 11 series will be the first smartphones on the market to do so, and potentially by a hair; Apple’s chip for its next Pro phones that presumably launch in September is also expected to use the 2nm process. Google is rumored to raise the starting storage of the base Pixel 11 and the base Pixel 11 Pro to 256GB, up from the 128GB floor with the Pixel 10 and Pixel 10 Pro. However, early Pixel 11 Pro listings have stated that the Pixel 11 Pro will have 12GB of RAM. If accurate, that would be down from the 16GB of RAM found in the Pixel 10 Pro lineup. And expect the whole Pixel lineup to have a higher starting price, as a Google VP recently told 9to5Google that the Pixel family will get pricing “adjustments” due to the memory crisis.  The Pixel Watch 5 [Image: A leaked marketing render of the Pixel Watch 5. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/pixel-watch-5-coral.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] We already know that Google has manufactured at least one device called the Pixel Watch 5 thanks to, uh, Borderlands creator Randy Pitchford. In a May post that included two images, Pitchford said that a friend found the watch underwater while scuba diving. But recently, Google briefly teased the watch for an August 12th launch, so we should see more soon. Leaked renders of the Pixel Watch 5 indicate that it may come in colors including black, polished silver, yellow gold, and a brass-y color, though the overall design looks quite similar to the Pixel Watch 4. Specs obtained by MyMobiles say that the new watch comes in 41 and 45mm screen sizes with battery life rated at 30 and 40 hours, respectively, matching the Pixel Watch 4. MyMobiles says that the Pixel Watch 5 will get 64GB of storage, which is double the 32GB of storage available previously. On the software side, marketing materials obtained by MyMobiles suggest that Gemini Intelligence — which Google revealed earlier this year for Android phones — will be a big feature for the Pixel Watch 5 this year. One apparent marketing slide calls Gemini Intelligence a “personal, proactive assistant” that can proactively surface helpful information for you. A feature called “Proactive Suggestions” will also be able to help you reply to messages by recommending “context-aware replies” based on a conversation. The marketing materials also promise that the new watch will have Google’s “most accurate sleep tracking yet.”  However, like with the Pixel phones, expect higher prices. MyMobiles reports that the 41mm Wi-Fi model may start at $399, up from the Pixel Watch 4’s $349.99, while the 45mm Wi-Fi model could start at $429, up from $399.99. The Pixel Buds Pro 2 in a new color [Image: A leaked marketing render of new Pixel Buds. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/image-7.png?quality=90&strip=all] Google first launched the Pixel Buds Pro 2 in 2024, but two years on, it seems as if the company is just going to launch a new color instead of refreshing the product. An apparent marketing image leaked by Evan Blass shows new earbuds in a nice olive green color

chineseContent: 每年的这个时候：周三，谷歌将举办年度 Pixel 小工具的 Made by Google 硬件发布会。谷歌本身已经预告了新的平板式和可折叠 Pixel 智能手机，但泄露的消息还表明，该公司可能会发布更新的手表、熟悉的耳塞的新颜色，或许还有一款全新的类似 AirTag 的物品追踪器。然而，不同寻常的是，谷歌的活动在晚上举行：它于周三东部时间下午 6 点/太平洋时间下午 3 点开始，而不是像许多其他科技活动一样在下午早些时候或上午中旬开始。这次它有一位名人主持人特雷弗·诺亚（Trevor Noah）。更奇怪的是：正如 9to5Google 所指出的，Google Store 主页有 Pixel 11 预购倒计时，将于美国东部时间周三上午 10 点结束，这比发布会本身早了几个小时。这可能意味着有关谷歌新设备的所有细节将在该公司举办正式发布会之前很久正式公布。  以下是我们预计谷歌本周将宣布的内容。如果您想观看现场直播，可以在 YouTube 上观看。 Pixel 11 系列 [图片：泄露的 Pixel 11 Pro Fold 营销渲染图。 https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/6608d2c0-7707-4156-82ca-a44b58a90bd1_1440x800.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] 谷歌在宣传活动时已经暗示了其新手机，包括更新的 Pro 和可折叠手机的影子。但新的智能手机可能很大程度上是迭代更新。  谷歌预计将发布四款新智能手机：Pixel 11、Pixel 11 Pro、Pixel 11 Pro XL 和 Pixel 11 Pro Fold。根据泄露的图像，它们看起来应该与 Pixel 10 系列大致相同，尽管它们的相机栏似乎是全黑的，
